_note: A Government death-cum-retirement gratuity received on the employee's death, under other sources: deducted in full (D-196; rulebook OS-GRATUITY-DEATH-001). TY 2026-27: Income-tax Act, 2025 s.93(1)(h) "for income in the nature of gratuity as referred in section 19(2)(g), received on the death of the employee, the entire amount" (p.142); s.19(2)(g): the gratuity "received under the revised pension rules of the Central Government, or the Central Civil Services (Pension) Rules, 2021; or … any similar scheme" for Union, all-India, State and local-authority services (p.46). Another employer's gratuity paid on a death has no clause and is OtherSourceKind.OTHER (W-079g). The salary head's counterpart is RET-GRATUITY-GOVERNMENT. TY 2025-26: Income-tax Act, 1961 s.10(10)(i) "any death-cum-retirement gratuity received under the revised Pension Rules of the Central Government … or under any similar scheme …" (thc p.71) — an exemption reaching the same gratuity; its introducedBy as RET-GRATUITY-GOVERNMENT's. Every regime.

introducedBy.instrumentCitation: Finance Act, 2023 (8 of 2023), s.52 — the new regime of s.115BAC(1A), whose s.115BAC(2)(i) does not exclude s.10(10) to (10C), so the entry applies in every regime
